note: Header synonyms for laboratory genotype tables (brief A.6 header rule; route-register genetic-file-ingest-v1.pgtTable). Each header cell is lower-cased and stripped of every non-alphanumeric character, then matched by exact equality against one list here; substring and fuzzy matching are forbidden. A file is a pgt_table when at least three of the six fields resolve. The forbidden list names header cells a browser drops before any byte leaves it and a server refuses before any write: a sex, gender or karyotype column never enters Inherit (X10.2).
